# Up Cuts Hair Designers

> Up Cuts is a locally owned hair salon in Aiken, South Carolina. Walk-ins are welcome, and customers may join an online waitlist before visiting.

## About

Donna, Sandy, and Jonathan left Great Clips to open Up Cuts. The local stylists report more than 30 years of combined experience.

## What we offer

- Walk-in haircut service
- Public listings include children's cuts, coloring, blow-dry services, and keratin treatments; availability and pricing should be confirmed directly
- After-hours appointments may be available by request, with an additional charge
- Discounts are published for military members, first responders, and college students with valid identification

## Location and contact

- Address: 156 University Parkway, Aiken, SC 29801
- Phone: 803-226-0510
- Email: Upcuts102@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; Saturday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; Sunday closed
- Waitlist: https://www.waitlist.me/w/upcutswaitinglist
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Upcutsllc
- Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/biz/upcuts-aiken

## Notes for accuracy

These facts were compiled from Up Cuts' current public website and corroborating public directories on July 17, 2026. Service details, discounts, team membership, suite number, and the final site URL should be confirmed with the business before launch.
